userText: Draft a send_message for dispute PP-R-BLK-10200001. First read the dispute with get_dispute_detail and the demo store order with get_store_order. Use the store order id from the checklist item "order" (its source id looks like order:JH-1042, so the order id is JH-1042, not the dispute id). Then call draft_response with action "send_message", the checklist items exactly as get_dispute_detail returned them (id, present, source_id) and your text. Write the text only from facts in those records. The only dollar amounts you may use are the disputed amount and the offer amount the tools returned; the server rejects any other amount. If draft_response returns an error, fix the text and call it again. Nothing is sent: the seller reviews and approves the card.

The order was delivered by USPS (tracking 9400111899223100000118) on 2026-10-29. You mentioned you have photos of the label.
